data.one_liner: Package to translate coordinates into locations and addresses into coordinates.
data.what_it_does: It provides a basic implementation of the geocode.xyz API in Dart. It exposes two main methods: forward geocoding to translate an address into latitude and longitude coordinates, and reverse geocoding to translate coordinates into a real address.
use_when: You need to convert a physical street address into geographic coordinates.
You need to look up a street address or location details from latitude and longitude coordinates.
avoid_when: You require an offline geocoding solution, as this package makes network requests to geocode.xyz.
You need high-volume requests without considering the rate limits and pricing plans of the underlying API.
strengths: Simple and straightforward API for forward and reverse geocoding.
Includes helpful typed exceptions for handling common error states like throttled requests or empty results.
weaknesses: Relies on a third-party web service (geocode.xyz) which has strict free-tier rate limits.
